items.html: Thus it is found that in the GAR of the Ehyeh of the totality of the Garon there are two Ehyeh of Yudin. And afterward, in the three middle [letters] of the Ehyeh that are in the totality of the Garon, there are two Ehyeh of the filling of Alephin. And afterward, in the three lower [letters] of the Ehyeh of the Garon, there are two Ehyeh of the filling of Heyin. Also, just as the three YHV of Hochma are included in the last YHV of MB [42], so in Bina, the six Ehyeh are included in two Ehyeh, which in gematria are MB [42].
